title: Lane-Scoped Recovery
summary: SoraNet mechanisms that rebuild state for a single lane without halting the entire network. When a lane experiences issues, the system can recover that lane's WSV and Kura state independently while other lanes continue processing transactions normally, maintaining overall network availability.
